artifact.summary: Qiskit circuit for the first-order Lie-Trotter product (eq_3) of U(t)=exp(-i(|w><w|+|s><s|)t) on n<=12 qubits with m steps. Each factor exp(-i phi |w><w|) is X-conjugated multi-controlled phase, and exp(-i phi |s><s|) is H^n-conjugated phase on |0...0>. No state preparation or measurement is included.
register_layout: Qubits 0..n-1 form the search register q; qubit 0 is the least significant bit of the basis index x; marked integer w is encoded in this little-endian convention.

equation_mapping.explanation: Assumed Hamiltonian H=|w><w|+|s><s|; it is not built as a matrix, only its two projector exponentials appear as Trotter factors.
Exact evolution U(t)=exp(-iHt) is the target being approximated; it is not constructed as a dense operator.

equation_mapping.code_location: build_circuit loop over m steps with _phase_on_basis
equation_mapping.explanation: Implements (exp(-i|w><w|t/m) exp(-i|s><s|t/m))^m, with the s-factor applied first as the right-hand operator.
Reflection-operator construction is the alternative discretisation and is not implemented here.
Grover iteration and success probability formula belong to the reflection option; not implemented.

specification_changes.change: Scope narrowed to the Lie-Trotter option only, generalised to n qubits (1..12), arbitrary marked index, real t, and m steps.
specification_changes.reason: The task requires one explicit construction; the reflection scheme is not fully specified.
The paper's logarithmic-error scheme is unspecified, and this is a separate construction.

specification_changes.change: The projector |s><s| exponential is realised as H^n exp(-i phi|0..0><0..0|) H^n, using |s>=H^n|0>.
specification_changes.reason: Gives an exact gate-level decomposition of each Trotter factor.

assumptions: Hamiltonian H=|w><w|+|s><s| with hbar=1, as in eq_1.
Each projector exponential is implemented exactly, including global phase, using multi-controlled phase gates.
Little-endian encoding of marked state w.
unresolved_issues: The paper's actual Hamiltonian and time convention are unknown.
The reflection scheme with logarithmic error scaling is not reconstructed.
Error bounds and complexity claims are not verified by this circuit.

validation.detail: Circuit built and transpiled successfully; no independent correctness reference selected.
